records.raw_text: The Groundwater Drought Indices indicate that in Post-monsoon 2025 , groundwater conditions across India remained largely stable, with 91% of monitoring stations showing no deficit . However, localized deficits were observed in several regions notably in Meghalaya, Nagaland, and the Dadar Nagar Havili & Daman & Diu.
